name: ma_crossover_momentum_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the 2-minute EMA crosses above the 10-minute EMA with positive 1-minute spot return, multiple VWAP-benchmarked and systematic momentum algorithms simultaneously detect a directional regime shift and start building positions in parallel. This synchronous institutional order flow creates a self-reinforcing burst lasting 30-120 seconds — clean on NIFTY because the index aggregates individual stock noise and institutional TWAP orders must execute continuously, not in sporadic spikes. The freshness filter (crossover within last 5 minutes) prevents entry into stale trends where the momentum wave has already peaked; only the early acceleration phase is targeted.
core_signal_oneliner: Fresh 2-minute/10-minute EMA crossover with 1-minute momentum confirmation within 5 minutes of crossover
